'''Yougga''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Yougga lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] and had the ambition to become Cularin's most notorious [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. To this end, she formed a smuggling organization. However, her employees were just as inexperienced as she was and they couldn't decide what to smuggle or from where they could obtain a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. She and her employees visited the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] [[The Chasm|Chasm]] the day after it was attacked by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Raik Muun]], as they wanted to be there in case something else interesting happened.
